domain_rule.method: case-insensitive token match over provider title, description, keywords, categories and subjects

DRYAD.ordering: provider default ordering as captured; no retry-dependent extension
DRYAD.structured_publication_relation: relatedWorks[].relationship == primary_article with a DOI identifier
DRYAD.direct_download: _links.stash:download.href must be present and use HTTPS

FIGSHARE.query_cross_product: all frozen domain queries x item_type
FIGSHARE.structured_publication_relation: resource_doi DOI, or related_materials DOI with relation IsSupplementTo/IsDerivedFrom/References, distinct from the object DOI
FIGSHARE.direct_download: download_disabled != true and at least one files[].download_url HTTPS entry
mirror_exclusions: resource hosted by another counted provider when Figshare is only a metadata mirror

HARVARD_DATAVERSE.structured_publication_relation: citation/publication metadata contains publicationIDType DOI and publicationIDNumber DOI in a provider-defined publication field
HARVARD_DATAVERSE.direct_download: at least one latestVersion.files[].dataFile persistentId or id with restricted == false and storageIdentifier present
HARVARD_DATAVERSE.citation_only_rule: citation or title without structured publication DOI is CANNOT_CHECK_PAIR_IDENTITY

DATACITE.query_cross_product: all frozen domain queries x Dataset/Software
DATACITE.counting_rule: never counted without separately captured item-specific rights and direct-download authority from the underlying host
DATACITE.mirror_rule: never creates provider disjointness for a DOI already counted at its content host

all_required: provider-structured article relation rather than title or keyword inference
at least one unrestricted HTTPS direct-download identity
content provider is not Zenodo and object is not a provider mirror
domain is prospectively assigned by the frozen discovery rule
no duplicate publication DOI within a domain x mechanism cell
no duplicate object concept DOI within a domain x mechanism cell
not_independent_units: API records for the same object
unit_eligibility.concept_doi_normalization: lowercase; strip doi:/https://doi.org/; strip terminal .vN for deduplication only; retain exact DOI in evidence
unit_eligibility.publication_doi_normalization: lowercase; strip doi:/https://doi.org/; do not otherwise rewrite
unit_eligibility.author_lineage: normalized sorted author identity signature; missing or ambiguous author identity is CANNOT_CHECK_AUTHOR_LINEAGE
unit_eligibility.provider_capture: one content-host provider family per object; discovery aggregators and mirrors never add a family

allocation_gate.candidate_pool_gate_per_cell: at least 48 eligible unique candidate units
allocation_gate.source_disjoint_gate_per_cell: at least two countable content-provider families and at least 8 units assignable to a replication family disjoint from the primary provider family
allocation_gate.lineage_gate: primary, replication and reserve allocations have no duplicate publication DOI, concept DOI, exact artifact or normalized author lineage
allocation_gate.adjudication_gate: all 48 units still require outcome-blind external natural-pair and material-claim adjudication

falsifiable_decision_rule.positive_if: every one of the eight frozen cells passes candidate_pool_gate, source_disjoint_gate, lineage_gate and exact rights/download/relation checks
falsifiable_decision_rule.shortfall_if: any cell has fewer than 48 eligible unique units or fewer than 8 source-family-disjoint replication units
falsifiable_decision_rule.cannot_check_if: transport incompleteness or ambiguity in rights, relation, provider identity, download authority, domain, or author lineage prevents the relevant gate from being evaluated
falsifiable_decision_rule.no_compensation: surplus in any provider, mechanism or domain cannot offset a short cell

forbidden: eligible natural pairs without external adjudication
claim_boundary.manuscript_wording_rule: write only source-feasibility wording licensed by captured evidence; never widen to performance or confirmation
